summary: An order update whose trading symbol is not the master's broker symbol but whose token is: the web finds the OpenAlgo symbol by the token, the desktop passes the raw symbol on.

notes: The web tries the token first, then the broker symbol (order_adapter.py:45-68).

deviations.reason: The web resolves an order update's OpenAlgo symbol by the instrument token first, then the broker symbol; the desktop looks up the broker symbol only and passes an unknown one on raw, so an update whose trading symbol differs from the master's names a symbol no book or strategy knows.
deviations.ref: websocket_proxy/order_adapter.py:45-68; arrow_order_adapter.py:101-106; audit remaining brokers matrix (Arrow: no token fallback); BKD-01
